requirement.statement: The project SHALL migrate valuable legacy interpreter test behavior to the new RuntimeInterpreter baseline and remove duplicate old interpreter regressions.

case.given: Legacy interpreter assertions are already covered by RuntimeInterpreter tests
case.when: The test suite is merged into the new runtime baseline
case.then: The project SHALL delete or replace those duplicate legacy assertions

case.given: The legacy Interpreter API remains present
case.when: The old regression suite is reduced
case.then: The project SHALL keep only a minimal compatibility smoke suite for EvalSync, ExecAsync, and state-based execution

case.given: Old tests cover loop and branch behavior
case.when: The behavior is still part of the current language surface
case.then: The project SHALL add RuntimeInterpreter tests using current Kon syntax

case.given: Old tests cover logical and infix macro behavior
case.when: The behavior is still part of the current language surface
case.then: The project SHALL add RuntimeInterpreter tests for short-circuit and mixed logical expression behavior

case.given: A caller reuses one RuntimeInterpreter runtime instance
case.when: The caller evaluates multiple scripts sequentially
case.then: The runtime SHALL preserve expected state across evaluations

case.given: A script needs to interact with a host JavaScript object
case.when: The script invokes the new RuntimeInterpreter host bridge API
case.then: The runtime SHALL provide an equivalent capability to the old js_call and js_apply business behavior

case.given: A script function is exported through the embedding API
case.when: Host JavaScript calls the exported callable
case.then: The callable SHALL bind parameters, execute through RuntimeInterpreter, and return the script result

case.given: Legacy tests cover timer or event queue behavior
case.then: The project SHALL NOT migrate event queue scheduling semantics in this track

case.given: Legacy tests cover await_host_fn style async host interop
case.then: The project SHALL NOT migrate async host interop semantics in this track

case.given: Legacy tests cover self-update assignment syntax
case.then: The project SHALL NOT migrate self-update operators in this track
